h1: The 6 Best Gucci Rimless Sunglasses of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 6 rimless designer sunglasses, five Gucci and one Versace, scored on fit, frame metal, lens size, kit and warranty.
summary: The Gucci GG2174S mask is the boldest rimless pair here, with a 99 mm lens and a full luxury kit. The narrow rectangular Gucci is the quiet, wearable choice, and the GG1221S with the interlocking logo is the best-documented fit. The Versace VE 2245 is the only non-Gucci pair and the cheapest way into the rimless look.
intro: Rimless sunglasses look weightless because the lens is the frame. That is also why they are unforgiving. With no rim to absorb a knock, the lens is drilled and bolted to the bridge and temples, so a loose screw or a dropped case shows up as a crack or a tilted lens, not a bent wire.

This ranking covers six designer pairs: five Gucci and one Versace. We worked from the listing dimensions, lens colours, kit contents and warranty wording, and we say plainly where a listing is thin. Gucci did not make or endorse any pick that is not Gucci's own, and the Versace is flagged as such wherever it appears.

products.name: Gucci GG2174S Lettering Logo Full Lens Rimless Mask Horsebit Hardware Sunglasses with Luxury Eyewear Kit
products.verdict: A single-lens mask with the most complete listing and the most dramatic shape here.
products.description:
The GG2174S is a full-lens rimless mask, made in Japan, with a silver front, black temples and a grey lens. The listing gives full measurements: 99 mm lens width, 58.4 mm lens height, a 1 mm bridge and 110 mm temples. It ships with a velvet hard case, a satin pouch, a cloth and a warranty booklet.

It ranks first because it is the only pair here that is a true design statement while still publishing every fit number. A shield lens covers more of the brow and cheek than any other pair in this list, which is the benefit and the risk. Compared with the narrow rectangular Gucci below, it needs a confident face and a larger head.

Buy it if you want the louder look and have a medium to large face. The 110 mm temples are short, so check the fit if you have a wide head, and the listing does not state a UV rating.

keySpecs.label: Kit
keySpecs.value: Velvet case, pouch, cloth, warranty booklet

products.idealFor: Anyone wanting a high-impact rimless mask with a full kit.
products.skipIf: You prefer a subtle frame or have a wide head.

products.name: Gucci Rectangular Narrow Rimless Sunglasses, Gold-Black-Grey, One Size
products.verdict: The easiest rimless Gucci to wear daily, though its listing barely describes it.
products.description:
This is a narrow rectangular rimless pair with gold, black and grey colouring, listed as one size. It is the only Gucci in this ranking that is plainly named as rimless in its title, and it sits in the $200 to $500 bucket.

It takes second place for shape alone. The narrow rectangle is the most forgiving rimless silhouette, flattering round faces and rarely looking dated, which makes it a better everyday wear than the GG2174S. What holds it back is the listing, which gives no lens width, bridge, temple length or UV rating, so you are buying on photos.

It is right for someone who wants one subtle designer pair for work and travel. Ask the seller for the measurements and the lens rating before ordering, since one size listed is not a fit guarantee.
pros: Neutral grey lens and gold hardware
products.idealFor: Daily wear where you want a quiet designer look.
products.skipIf: You need exact measurements before buying.

products.name: Gucci GG1221S GG Interlocking Logo Pilot-Shaped Non-Polarized Sunglasses for Men
products.verdict: A pilot shape with the clearest fit numbers, but check whether the frame is truly rimless.
products.description:
The GG1221S in this listing is a pilot-shaped pair with a gold frame, grey lenses and black temples carrying the interlocking GG logo. It gives a 56 mm lens width, 16 mm bridge, 140 mm temples and 35.9 mm lens height, and states that the lenses are non-polarized.

It ranks third because those measurements let you compare against a pair that already fits you, which no other Gucci listing here allows. The listing does not call the frame rimless, so confirm the construction from the photos before buying if that is your priority. The grey lens suits general daylight use, but without polarisation it will not cut glare off water or roads.

It suits men who want a metal pilot with Gucci branding and a standard fit. The 35.9 mm lens height is moderate, so the look is more classic than the mask.
cons: Logo is more visible than the narrow pair
products.idealFor: Buyers who compare measurements before ordering.
products.skipIf: You must have a strictly rimless frame.

products.name: Versace VE 2245 10028G Gold Metal Rimless Sunglasses Grey Gradient Lens
products.verdict: The lowest-cost rimless in this guide, and the only one that is not a Gucci.
products.description:
The Versace VE 2245 is a gold metal rimless pair with a grey gradient lens, sitting in the $100 to $200 bucket. It is not a Gucci product, and we include it as the value option in the designer rimless group.

It ranks fourth because it is named rimless and costs a full price bucket less than the Gucci pairs. A gradient lens is darker at the top and lighter at the bottom, which helps when you glance at a dashboard or phone. The listing gives no lens size, no temple length and no UV rating, so it loses ground to the better-documented Gucci pairs.

It makes sense for someone who wants the rimless style for less. Verify the seller and the measurements first, since there is little detail to go on.
products.idealFor: Value-minded buyers who want a designer rimless pair.
products.skipIf: You want a Gucci or need listed measurements.

products.name: Gucci GG1221S 003 Gold/Green Rectangular Men's Sunglasses
products.verdict: The GG1221S in gold and green, with a rectangular look and almost no listing detail.
products.description:
This is the GG1221S model in a gold and green colourway, described as rectangular and suitable for everyday and outdoor wear. The listing gives no lens size, bridge, temple length or UV rating, and does not state that the frame is rimless.

It ranks fifth because the green lens is the main difference from the interlocking-logo pair, and a green tint tends to brighten colours, but the listing says nothing more about it. Without measurements or a stated construction, it is a riskier purchase than the pair above, which at least publishes its fit.

Choose it only if the colourway appeals and you are comfortable checking the photos closely for rimless construction. Otherwise the better-documented GG1221S is the safer buy.
pros: Gold frame suits warm skin tones
Same model line as the third pick
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a green tint in the GG1221S line.
products.skipIf: You need fit data or confirmed rimless construction.

products.name: Gucci GG1221S 004 Gold/Red Rectangular Men's Sunglasses
products.verdict: The same model with a red lens, ranked last because red is the hardest tint to wear.
products.description:
This is the GG1221S in gold and red, described as rectangular and suitable for everyday and outdoor wear. The listing offers no lens width, temple length, bridge or UV rating, and says nothing on rimless construction.

It finishes behind the green colourway because a red lens shifts colour perception more than green or grey, which many wearers find tiring for driving or long outdoor days. It is a fashion tint first. The listing detail is identical in thinness to the 003, so the only deciding factor is how the lens colour sits with your style.

Buy it as a second pair for the look, not as a primary sunglass. Confirm UV protection and construction with the seller before paying a designer price.
pros: Same model family as the others
products.skipIf: You want a primary pair for driving or glare.

methodology.title: Fit data and measurements
methodology.description: We rewarded listings that state lens width, bridge and temple length, since rimless frames cannot be adjusted much after purchase.

methodology.title: Frame construction
methodology.description: We looked for explicit rimless language and metal frame details, and marked any listing that does not say how the lens is mounted.

methodology.title: Lens colour and coverage
methodology.description: We compared tints, gradients and lens height for daylight use, and noted where polarisation or UV protection is not stated.

methodology.title: Kit and warranty
methodology.description: We checked for cases, pouches, cloths and warranty booklets, because they signal an authorised supply chain.

methodology.title: Everyday wearability
methodology.description: We weighed shape, logo prominence and weight, favouring pairs you can wear daily over novelty designs.

whatMatters.detail: Rimless means the lens is drilled and bolted to the bridge and temples with no rim to protect the edge. That makes the mounting screws the weak point and a drop more costly. On a listing, look for the word rimless in the title or description, and keep a tiny screwdriver kit handy.

UV400 means the lens blocks light up to 400 nanometres, covering UVA and UVB. Dark tint alone does not guarantee it. None of the listings here state a rating, so look for UV400 or 100 percent UV protection on the product page, and ask the seller if it is missing.

Three numbers decide fit: lens width, bridge and temple length. A pair that is 56 mm lens width, 16 mm bridge and 140 mm temples is a standard medium. Compare these against a pair you own, and be cautious of one size listings with no data.

Designer eyewear is heavily counterfeited. A genuine pair normally ships with a hard case, pouch, cloth and warranty booklet, as the GG2174S lists. Buy from a seller that shows these items and a return policy, and avoid listings with stock photos only.

Polarised lenses cut horizontal glare from water, snow and roads, while non-polarised lenses simply darken. The GG1221S interlocking pair is stated as non-polarized. If you drive a lot or fish, that matters, and a fashion pair is a poor tool for the job.

howToChoose.intro: Rimless frames show your face more than any other style, so shape matters.

cards.label: Mask lens
cards.text: One wide lens covers brow and cheek, giving maximum coverage and drama. Picks: Gucci GG2174S.

cards.label: Rectangular lens
cards.text: Two smaller lenses sit lower on the face for a subtler look. Picks: Gucci Rectangular Narrow, GG1221S 003 and 004.

howToChoose.note: Default to the narrow rectangle unless you want the mask on purpose.

howToChoose.subheading: For Buying Authentic Designer Eyewear Specifically

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A listed case, pouch, cloth and warranty booklet, a stated made-in-Japan origin, a seller with a return policy, and an explicit UV400 or 100 percent UV statement.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The GG2174S and GG1221S interlocking listings both name their kit contents. The Versace lists no kit, so confirm the seller first.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You want full measurements and a complete kit. The GG2174S and interlocking GG1221S supply both.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You are chasing the rimless look. The Versace VE 2245 costs a bucket less, and the lens style is the same idea.

faq.q: Are all of these sunglasses made by Gucci?
faq.a: No. Five of the six are Gucci models, but the Versace VE 2245 is a Versace product, and it is flagged as such. Gucci has not endorsed any pick in this guide.

faq.q: Do these sunglasses have UV400 protection?
faq.a: None of the listings state a UV rating. Look for UV400 or 100 percent UV protection on the product page, and ask the seller if it is missing. A dark tint alone does not prove protection.

faq.q: Is a rimless frame worth it over a full rim?
faq.a: If you want the lightest look, yes, and the GG2174S and narrow rectangle deliver it. The tradeoff is durability, because the lens edge is exposed. Always use the hard case that ships with the Gucci kits.

faq.q: How do I make sure I am buying authentic designer sunglasses?
faq.a: Buy from sellers that show the case, pouch, cloth and warranty booklet, as the GG2174S and GG1221S interlocking listings do. Check the return policy, and be suspicious of prices far below the $100 to $200 and $200 to $500 buckets.

faq.q: How do I look after rimless lenses?
faq.a: Clean with the microfiber cloth and avoid pressing on the lens edge. Check the mounting screws every few months, and store the pair in the velvet case. Do not leave it in a hot car, which can stress the coatings.

faq.q: Will these suit a larger head?
faq.a: The GG1221S interlocking pair has 140 mm temples, a standard length. The GG2174S has 110 mm temples, which are short, so measure before buying if your head is wide.

finalTake: The GG2174S is the pair to buy if you want a rimless Gucci that makes a statement and tells you its size. The narrow rectangular Gucci is the better daily wear, as long as you accept the thin listing. The Versace VE 2245 is a fair way into the style for less money, and the two coloured GG1221S models are for buyers who already know they want that tint. Whatever you pick, buy from a seller that shows the kit and confirm UV400.
